test_title: PYST 26: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 30 Jun 2023 Shift 4)
subject: maths
question: Simple interest gained on ₹9,000 at the rate of 8% is equal to ₹2,160. Calculate the time.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs.9000

Rate = 8%

Simple interest (S.I) = 2160

**Formula used:**

Time = (S.I × 100)/(P × R)

**Calculation:**

Time = (S.I × 100)/(P × R)

⇒ (2160 × 100)/(9000 × 8)

⇒ 24/8 = 3 years

**∴ The correct answer is 3 years.**
